plugins.name: no-co-authored
plugins.description: Blocks git commits whose message carries a Co-Authored-By trailer or the Claude Code footer, asking Claude to recreate the message without them.

plugins.name: git-sign-key
plugins.description: Signs git commits with a ~/.claude/sign.key file via SSH signing instead of the ssh-agent.

plugins.name: cctools-edit
plugins.description: Installs the cc-tools binary for the host OS and routes Read/Write/Edit/MultiEdit through it so file encodings (Latin-1/Windows-1252/UTF-8) are preserved instead of corrupted.

plugins.name: branch-management
plugins.description: Branch lifecycle skills. new-branch cuts a fresh branch inline; new-pr runs iterative parallel review rounds (claude/codex/copilot/coderabbit reviewers) backed by subagents, applies verified fixes between rounds, opens a PR/MR via gh or glab, and watches CI until green. Optionally refreshes a graphify output folder on new-branch and before the PR push (separate commit). Uses context-mode to keep heavy script output out of context when it is installed, with a native Bash fallback otherwise.

plugins.name: superpowers-automation
plugins.description: A new-work pipeline orchestrator that classifies a description as feature/fix/refactor and runs the matching flow (feature/refactor: branch -> brainstorm -> review -> plan -> review -> implement; fix: systematic-debugging), plus the file-advisor-improver reviser and an opt-in plan hook forcing Subagent-Driven implementation.

plugins.name: claude-code-knowledge
plugins.description: Lookup skill plus harness-optimized reference files for authoring and configuring Claude Code — skills, subagents, hooks, slash commands, MCP, plugins, CLAUDE.md memory, and settings — plus a read-only expert agent that replaces the built-in claude-code-guide. Retrieves only the relevant section into context.

plugins.name: cave-context
plugins.description: Unifies caveman + context-mode into one non-competing MCP server: proxies context-mode ctx_* tools and aggregates both plugins' hooks.

plugins.name: js-lsp
plugins.description: JavaScript-only LSP via vtsls, with LSP-first enforcement hooks

plugins.name: ts-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript-only LSP via vtsls, with LSP-first enforcement hooks
